title: purple-mimi 5b: the libpurple 3 glue
description: The libpurple 3 glue (docs/design/purple-mimi.md §9) for everything steps 5 and 6 have, over the same Rust core: PurpleProtocol subclass, connection, rooms as CHANNEL and direct rooms as DM conversations, messages with ids, edits (edited, edited_at), replying_to, attachments, reactions and invites as text until libpurple 3 has them, commands, devices in the connection action menu, the takeover rule of §6.6. Plus the headless libpurple 3 test host (libpurple built with -Dgtkui=false in a Debian 13 podman container; §11). Tracks the latest Pidgin 3 alpha. About 2,000 to 2,800 lines of C for the glue and 500 to 800 for the host (estimate).
